title: Senior Software Engineer - FinTech Platform
job_summary: This Senior Software Engineer - FinTech Platform role is for a lead engineer in a fast-paced FinTech startup, focusing on designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput backend APIs for next-generation payment systems. The role requires 5+ years of experience, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, and strong proficiency in Python or Go, SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and RESTful API design. The successful candidate will lead a small team, mentor junior developers, drive architectural decisions, and take extreme ownership, operating with significant autonomy. Preferred qualifications include experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, along with domain knowledge in FinTech or payment processing. The role values adaptability and a strong willingness to learn.
